# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v2.2.0

这一版解决一个每天都会遇到的小摩擦：**你在细则里存下的问题截图，终于可以直接拿出来了。**

UI 出问题的时候你的做法是立刻截图、粘进行动细则，之后再去解决。但想把它交给 AI 看时，只能点开原图重新截一次屏——重截会掉分辨率，而排查界面问题恰恰要靠像素对齐。现在细则里的图片可以右键「**复制原图**」：写进剪贴板的是思源资源库里的**原始文件字节**，PNG 完全不经解码与重采样，尺寸与像素和你当初粘贴的那张一模一样；也可以复制 `assets/…` 资源路径，方便在文字里引用同一张图。

同一版还带上了「今日」视图与切片撤销：层级浏览新增可记忆的「今日」筛选，只留今天仍有未完成切片的事务；在「今日」里取消某个事务的当日切片不再把你切到别的事务上；执行切片可以撤销完成，目标切片做满也不再自动结束事务，改回由你确认。

## 主要更新

- **图片右键「复制原图 / 复制资源路径」**：缩略图、阅读态正文图与放大弹窗里的原图都能右键。
  - 「复制原图」写进剪贴板的是资源库里的原文件字节：PNG 截图不经解码与重采样，尺寸、像素与当初粘贴的那张一致，可以直接粘到 AI 对话里做像素级比对，不必再截一次屏（重新截图会掉分辨率）。
  - 非 PNG（jpg／webp／gif／svg）先按原尺寸转成 PNG 再复制：只换容器、不改像素，动图只保留首帧。
  - 反馈带尺寸与体积（例如「已复制原图 · 1280×800 · 611 KB」）；剪贴板不可用、原图读不到或转码失败都会说明具体原因，不会静默失败。
  - 「复制资源路径」以文本复制 `assets/…`；命中区只有图片本身，体积角标与右上角「×」按钮右键不弹菜单。
- **层级浏览新增可记忆的「今日」视图**（置首，角标显示今天仍待办的事务数）：只看今天仍有未完成执行切片的事务，命中事务保留完整的长期领域→项目→任务→事务路径作为上下文，只有事务本身带蓝色「今日」标记；筛选状态随视图状态一起记住，重启插件仍停在离开时的筛选。此前只有行内「今日」标记、没有筛选入口，现在两者共用同一套判定，不会出现「标记说今日、筛选说不是」。
- **「今日」里取消当日切片不再跳到别的事务**：选中项被钉在视图里，连同上层路径继续显示并带「已移出今日」标记（悬停说明原因），详情面板与日历都不换人，把切片重新安排回今天即可恢复；只有主动点别的条目、切筛选、切范围或删除条目时才放下。
- **执行切片可撤销完成、今天用「今」标记**：点已完成的格子或用它的右键菜单即可撤销——今天退回「已安排」、过去日期退回「未完成」，已手动标记「已完成」的事务随之退回「进行中」，放弃过的切片保持只读。今天的格子与日期同排显示「今」，不额外占高度。
- **目标切片做满不再自动结束事务**（更正 2.1.0 的做法）：做满时只在切片日历上提示「目标切片已全部完成，事务是否也已完成？」，点「完成事务」才改状态；撤销导致不再满额时仍自动退回「进行中」。
- **执行切片卡片压掉一整行**：卡片够宽（≥620px）时「安排说明 + 完成/放弃本次切片」并入「0% 事务完成度 + 进度条」那一行；较窄时排在进度条下一行，但按钮始终与说明同排，不再随宽度或状态换行、跳动。按钮由 30px 收到 22px，说明过长先省略、悬停看全文；文案改为陈述事实（今天有安排时只写「今天已安排 N 片」）。

## 修复

- 修复细则缩略图**总是被挤成一行一张**：容器内容盒 ≤620px 时缩略图宽度为 `calc(50% - 4px)`，加上 1px 边框后实际外框变成 `50% - 2px`，两张加 8px 间隙超过 100%，于是一张一行——1440px 面板下详情栏内容盒正好 568px，属于命中区间，所以这是日常可见的路径。改为按 `border-box` 计算后恢复一行两张。
- 修复切片卡片按钮「跳到下一行」：说明与按钮此前按容器宽度在「并排/上下」之间切换，调整窗口宽度时按钮会跳位；现在同一档位内不切换布局。

## 升级说明

无需手动迁移：工作项、执行切片、生活节律、Checklist 与营养数据的结构均未变化，读写、修订号、轮换备份与写后复核流程保持原样。

一处行为变化请留意：**目标切片做满不再自动结束事务**。这是把 2.1.0 引入的自动规则改回由你确认——如果你在 2.1.0 期间已经习惯「做满即完成」，升级后做满时请在切片日历上点一次「完成事务」。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v2.2.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v2.2.0

This release removes a small daily friction: **the screenshots you store in an action detail can finally be taken back out.**

When the UI misbehaves you screenshot it immediately and paste it into the action detail, then deal with it later. Getting that image to an AI meant opening the original and screenshotting again — and a re-shot screenshot loses resolution, exactly when pixel alignment is what you need. Images in the detail now offer **Copy original image** on right-click: what reaches the clipboard is the **original file byte-for-byte** from the SiYuan asset library, so a PNG is never decoded or resampled and its size and pixels match what you pasted. You can also copy the `assets/...` path to reference the same image in prose.

The same release carries the Today view and slice undo: hierarchy browsing gained a remembered Today filter that keeps only transactions with unfinished slices today, cancelling a transaction's slice for today no longer switches you to another transaction, a completed slice can be undone, and filling every target slice no longer ends the transaction by itself — that is back in your hands.

## Highlights

- **Copy original image / Copy asset path on right-click**: available on thumbnails, images in the read-mode text, and the enlarged original in the preview dialog.
  - Copy original image writes the library's original file bytes: a PNG screenshot is never decoded or resampled, so size and pixels match what you pasted, ready for pixel-level comparison in an AI conversation instead of a fresh, lower-resolution screenshot.
  - Non-PNG images (jpg / webp / gif / svg) are transcoded to PNG at their original size first: only the container changes, never the pixels, and an animated GIF keeps its first frame.
  - The confirmation reports size and pixel dimensions (for example "Copied original image · 1280×800 · 611 KB"), and an unavailable clipboard, an unreadable asset, or a failed transcode each explains itself instead of failing silently.
  - Copy asset path copies `assets/...` as text. Only the image itself is a hit target: the size badge and the "×" remove button do not open the menu.
- **A remembered Today view in hierarchy browsing** (first position, with a badge counting today's slots): only transactions that still have unfinished execution slices today stay visible. A matching transaction keeps its full area → project → task → transaction path as context, and only the transaction itself carries the blue Today marker. The filter is remembered with the rest of the view state, so reopening the plugin returns to where you left. The list previously had only the inline Today marker with no filter entry; both now share one rule, so they can never disagree.
- **Cancelling today's slice inside Today no longer jumps to another transaction**: the selection is pinned in place, keeps its ancestor path, and shows a "moved out of today" marker (hover explains why). The detail pane and calendar never switch items, and scheduling the slice back onto today restores it. The pin is released only when you actively select another item, switch filter or scope, or delete the item.
- **A completed slice can be undone, and today is marked 今**: click a completed cell or use its context menu — today returns to Scheduled, a past date to Missed, a transaction you marked Done by hand falls back to In Progress, and abandoned slices stay read-only. Today's cell shows 今 on the same line as the date, so the marker costs no extra height.
- **Filling every target slice no longer ends the transaction by itself** (correcting the 2.1.0 behaviour): the calendar only asks "Target slices are all done — is the transaction done too?", and the state changes when you press Complete transaction. Undoing a completion that drops the item below its target still returns it to In Progress automatically.
- **The slice card lost a full row**: when the card is wide enough (≥620px) the scheduling note and the Complete / Abandon this slice actions merge into the "0% transaction progress + progress bar" row; on narrower cards they sit on the row under the bar, but the buttons always stay on the same line as the note instead of wrapping or jumping with width or state changes. Buttons shrank from 30px to 22px, a long note is truncated with an ellipsis and shown in full on hover, and the copy states facts ("1 slice scheduled today").

## Fixed

- Fixed detail thumbnails **always collapsing to one per row**: when the container content box is ≤620px wide the thumbnail width is `calc(50% - 4px)`, and the 1px border made the real outer box `50% - 2px`, so two thumbnails plus the 8px gap exceeded 100% — at a 1440px pane the detail content box is exactly 568px, inside that range, so this was the everyday path. Measuring against `border-box` restores two per row.
- Fixed the slice-card buttons jumping to the next line: the note and the buttons used to switch between side-by-side and stacked based on container width, so resizing the window moved the buttons. The layout no longer switches within a tier.

## Upgrading

No manual migration: the shape of work items, execution slices, life rhythm, checklist, and nutrition data is unchanged, and reading, writing, revision numbers, rotating backups, and write-then-verify all behave as before.

One behaviour change to note: **filling every target slice no longer ends the transaction by itself.** This reverts the automatic rule introduced in 2.1.0 back to your confirmation — if you relied on "full means done" during 2.1.0, press Complete transaction on the slice calendar once the target is full.

## Download

Download `package.zip` from this release's assets. Do not use GitHub's auto-generated "Source code" archives as a SiYuan plugin package.
